fable.w: This is a purely technical amendment that inserts a section number and heading into the Atomic Energy Act. The tempting reading is that the reference to "The Commission" signals an advisory body, but it is only a text marker for where the heading goes, and it refers to a federal agency in any case. No outside party is consulted, heard, or given a right to challenge any federal decision.
